customer_id.description: NULL = anonymous sale (safe no-op: nothing is selected, nothing is written)

sale_id.description: Source document (sales_sale.id, opaque). Idempotency key with the hub: the same sale recorded twice moves the totals once (customers#8). Absent = a `manual` ledger entry, not deduplicable.

total.description: Purchase amount in whole CENTS (ADR-0007). Feeds the customer's total_spent: a 2.20 here would leave it at 2 cents.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code as delivered by the event; stored on the ledger row.
